prompt: A `TTLCache` with a one minute TTL uses a `FakeClock` starting at midnight. An entry `a` is set, then the clock is advanced. Predict each `Get("a")`.
code:
clock := NewFakeClock(time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
cache := NewTTLCache(clock, time.Minute)
cache.Set("a", "1")
clock.Advance(59 * time.Second)
// first Get("a")
clock.Advance(time.Second)
// second Get("a")

trace.label: after one more second (60 s in total)

explain: An entry expires at set time plus TTL, and `expired` uses `!Before`, so exactly at that instant it is already gone. A fake clock makes this boundary testable without sleeping.
